title: Boundedness and Separation Between Induced and Non-Induced Covering Numbers
summary: There are four covering numbers $\mathrm{c}_g^{\mathcal{G}}(H),\mathrm{c}_u^{\mathcal{G}}(H),\mathrm{c}_l^{\mathcal{G}}(H),\mathrm{c}_f^{\mathcal{G}}(H)$, each of which measures in a slightly different way how well the edges of a graph $H$ (called a host) can be covered with graphs of a class $\mathcal{G}$ (called a guest class).
